name: Kurasawa Anzu
source:
Anzu is a short, raven-haired beauty with perfect proportions and a sharp tongue. Although many praise her for her beauty, a lot of men are scared off by her stern appearance. Her father is a government official with a strong sense of justice, and just like her father, Anzu is also strict and disciplined with a hatred of crime. Her inflexible personality makes a lot of people dislike her, but she is unaware of it all due to her father’s powerful position.
